crossRefs.note: It grieved me severely. Therefore I threw all Tobiah’s household stuff out of the room.
I contended with them, and cursed them, and struck certain of them, and plucked off their hair, and made them swear by…
All these servants of yours will come down to me, and bow down themselves to me, saying, “Get out, with all the people…
Moses was very angry, and said to Yahweh, “Don’t respect their offering. I have not taken one donkey from them, neither…
When he had looked around at them with anger, being grieved at the hardening of their hearts, he said to the man…
“Be angry, and don’t sin.” Don’t let the sun go down on your wrath,

translations.web: I was very angry when I heard their cry and these words.
translations.bsb: When I heard their outcry and these complaints, I became extremely angry,
translations.kjv: And I was very angry when I heard their cry and these words.
translations.asv: And I was very angry when I heard their cry and these words.
